    What you need to know about Marina Gate

    Marina Gate is a prominent residential complex located in the heart of Dubai Marina, one of the city’s most sought-after waterfront communities. Developed by Select Group, the project comprises three striking towers, each offering a blend of modern architecture and luxurious living. With construction completed in phases between 2018 and 2020, Marina Gate stands tall with over 50 floors in each tower, providing residents with panoramic views of the marina and city skyline. The development features a mix of apartments, penthouses, and retail spaces, catering to both families and professionals seeking a vibrant, upscale lifestyle. As a freehold property, Marina Gate offers ownership opportunities for both UAE nationals and expatriates.


    Key Facts

    • Developer: Select Group
    • Location: Dubai Marina, Dubai
    • Building Type: Residential
    • Available Unit Types: Studios, 1BR, 2BR, 3BR, Penthouses
    • Ownership Type: Freehold
    • Amenities:

      • State-of-the-art fitness centers and squash courts
      • Dedicated children’s play areas and pools
      • Landscaped gardens and outdoor seating zones
      • 24-hour concierge and security services
      • Secure covered parking for residents
      • Retail outlets and cafes at podium level
      • High-speed elevators and smart access systems
      • Sauna, steam rooms, and spa facilities
      • Multipurpose sports courts

    Location, Lifestyle and Amenities

    Marina Gate is strategically positioned along the northern edge of Dubai Marina, offering direct access to the marina promenade and stunning waterfront vistas. The towers are situated close to major arterial roads such as Sheikh Zayed Road, ensuring seamless connectivity to the rest of Dubai. The surrounding community is vibrant and cosmopolitan, characterized by luxury yachts, high-end dining, and a lively social scene, making it a prime address for urban living. Accessibility is a key advantage at Marina Gate, with multiple public transport options and pedestrian-friendly walkways. Residents benefit from proximity to tram and metro stations, as well as easy access to taxis and ride-hailing services, facilitating convenient commutes across the city. Residents of Marina Gate enjoy secure, covered parking within dedicated podium levels, with allocated spaces for each apartment. Visitor parking is available on a limited basis, and additional paid parking options can be found in nearby public lots within Dubai Marina.

    Donna

    Dubai Marina delivers on its promise of a vibrant, walkable lifestyle. The buzz of the neighbourhood is great - there's always energy, whether you're heading out for a morning coffee or an evening stroll. The Marina Walk is a genuine highlight, and the sheer variety of restaurants, cafés and shops on your doorstep is hard to beat. For anyone who wants convenience and a lively atmosphere, it genuinely delivers. The downsides are real though. Traffic can be seriously frustrating, particularly at peak hours, and the ongoing roadworks have added another layer of congestion that tests your patience. The neighbourhood can also tip into feeling overcrowded at weekends and during busier periods - which, depending on your mood, can make it feel less like a community and more like a tourist hotspot. Overall, a great place to live if you embrace the energy - just factor in the commute.

    Property types in Marina Gate

    Marina Gate offers a diverse selection of residential units, including studios, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as luxurious penthouses. The apartments are designed with open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and spacious balconies that maximize natural light and offer breathtaking marina or city views. High-quality finishes, modern kitchens, and ample storage spaces cater to the needs of families, professionals, and investors seeking premium waterfront living.


    Frequently asked questions

    Annual service charges at Marina Gate vary depending on the unit size and type. These charges typically cover the maintenance of common areas, security, and building amenities. For precise figures, it is advisable to consult the developer or property management, as rates are subject to periodic review and adjustment.
    Marina Gate offers residents a comprehensive range of amenities, including infinity pools, fully equipped gyms, squash and sports courts, children’s play areas, landscaped gardens, and retail outlets. Additional features include 24-hour concierge services, high-speed elevators, and secure parking, ensuring a comfortable and convenient lifestyle.
    Residents benefit from excellent connectivity, with easy access to Dubai Metro stations such as Sobha Realty and DMCC, as well as nearby tram and bus stops. The location also offers quick access to Sheikh Zayed Road, making it convenient for those commuting by car or using ride-hailing services.
    Yes, each apartment at Marina Gate comes with allocated covered parking spaces within the building’s secure podium levels. Visitor parking is also available, and additional public parking options can be found in the surrounding Dubai Marina area.
    Marina Gate is generally considered pet-friendly, allowing residents to keep pets in their apartments. However, it is recommended to check with the building management for any specific rules or restrictions regarding pet ownership to ensure compliance with community guidelines.
